text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the Make Debut. The season when young 
buds sprout. How is everyone doing out 
there...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan is... Digitan is... amidst this 
pure, crystalline clarity...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, this is enough to make you die 
of moe! Just look, Trainer, at all the 
Umamusume around us~."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
One of them is trembling with nerves, 
while the other has stars in her eyes...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, how precious can you get?! A Make 
Debut only happens once in a lifetime. To 
be part of such fresh, innocent 
moments..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*, I mean honestly, this is death by 
sheer blessedness, absolute death... 
Digitan wouldn't care whatever happens to 
her right now...
choice_data_list:
We've got a race coming right up, you 
know?!

We've got a race coming right up, you 
know?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! This is no time to be 
ascending to heaven...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now I find myself standing alongside 
fresh, blossoming little leaves. I cannot 
allow even the slightest shadow to fall 
upon this sacred day...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll run with everything I've got! With 
such an overflow of support, my strength 
is practically limitless!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
These eyes are my viewfinder. I shall burn 
those once-in-a-lifetime tears of joy and 
sweat of frustration from the Umamusume 
into memory, yes indeedy!

Whatever her motives might be, Agnes 
Digital headed for the race with 
dead-serious resolve not to be left 
behind.
